requirements.title: Daily transfer limit
requirements.text: A customer can transfer at most 5,000.00 EUR per calendar day; a transfer that would exceed the limit is rejected with a message.
acceptance_criteria: Given 4,999.99 EUR sent today, when 0.01 EUR is sent, then it succeeds

requirements.title: Transfer status lifecycle
requirements.text: A transfer moves from pending to completed or failed; a cancelled transfer cannot be completed.

requirements.title: Only own accounts visible
requirements.text: A customer sees only their own accounts and transfers; another user's transfer ID returns not found.

requirements.title: Payee name field
requirements.text: The payee name field accepts 2 to 70 characters including Unicode letters.

requirements.title: Legacy statement page
requirements.text: The legacy statement page remains reachable from the footer.
